title: Draconic Form
description:
The fine veins that glow red through your fleece pulse, then catch fire. You take the shape of a dragon.

You gain 2 new temporary {{caracteristique|Characteristics}}: {{physique-temporaire}} and {{mental-temporaire}}. Your {{physique-temporaire|Physical value}} is the sum of your {{force}}, {{dexterite}} and {{constitution}}, and your {{mental-temporaire|Mental value}} is the sum of your {{intelligence}}, {{esprit}} and {{charisme}}. A {{caracteristique}} of 0 or less adds nothing to its sum.

While {{FORDRA-001}} lasts, your {{physique-temporaire|Physical value}} replaces your {{force}}, {{dexterite}} and {{constitution}} for every purpose, your {{ca}}, maximum {{pdv}} and Initiative included. Your {{mental-temporaire|Mental value}} replaces your {{intelligence}}, {{esprit}} and {{charisme}} for every purpose, your maximum {{energie}} included and your {{memoire}} excepted. When you play {{FORDRA-001}}, your current {{pdv}} rise to your new maximum {{pdv}}.

While {{FORDRA-001}} lasts, your {{taille}} becomes {{grande}} if your {{physique-temporaire|Physical value}} is 4 or less, {{tres-grande}} if it is 5 to 8, and {{gigantesque}} if it is 9 or more. Your {{type-de-creature}} becomes {{dragon}}. Everything you wear and hold melds into you and has no effect until {{FORDRA-001}} ends. You can still speak, and you can cast your {{sort|Spells}} as if the Catalyseur you had equipped when you transformed were part of you. All the {{degats|damage}} you deal becomes {{degats-feu}}, except {{degats-contondant}}, {{degats-perforant}} and {{degats-tranchant}}.

{{FORDRA-001}} lasts until the end of your next {{tour}} if your {{mental-temporaire|Mental value}} is 4 or less, 1 minute if it is 5 to 8, and 10 minutes if it is 9 or more. On your {{tour}}, you can end it, which costs nothing. If your {{pdv}} drop to 0 while it lasts, you gain {{agonie}} as usual, then {{FORDRA-001}} ends.

When {{FORDRA-001}} ends, you return to your own form, and every value and every maximum you have goes back to what it was before you transformed, your current {{pdv}} and {{energie}} included. If it ended because your {{pdv}} dropped to 0, your current {{pdv}} stay at 0. The {{karma}} you spent to play it does not come back.

*We recommend printing a separate character sheet for your draconic form.*
